00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000037.title: Chapter 06 – Blank
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000037.synopsis: Mara finally walks the northern shore with the little map. Every cove she draws in is gone by morning. She stops drawing.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000037.notes: Chapter-as-file. The turn: she chooses not to know something.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000038.title: Chapter 07 – What the sea keeps
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000038.synopsis: Tomas finally says what was said on the crossing. Elin lets the fourth window stay bricked up. The tower goes back east while nobody watches.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000038.notes: Chapter-as-file. Resolve the crossing; do not resolve the father.
